user_problem: Authors need to determine whether a completed document covers every explicitly supplied content requirement and where each requirement is addressed.
unique_output: A traceability matrix linking each requirement to section evidence, coverage status, duplication or conflict, and unresolved gaps.
required_input: A complete document with section IDs, an explicit requirement list, required-versus-optional labels, and any supplied equivalence rules.
critical_rule: Mark a requirement covered only when the supplied section content satisfies its stated meaning; partial or merely related text must remain partial.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is source-note-to-outline; this audits a completed document against explicit content requirements rather than constructing an outline from source notes.
acceptance_scenario: Input requires an accountable owner and a limitations statement. The Methods section names the owner, while no section states limitations. Output marks owner coverage with its location and records the limitations requirement as a gap.
